initialization_manifest.limitations: Three observed instants, same repeated validation camera, approximate masks; no interpolation or physical tracking validation.

foreground_loss.rule: Full-image L1 +0.1*foreground mean L1 on available training masks only

near_clip_guard.factor_rule: Next power of two giving training board minimum depth >=0.3; no validation pixels or geometry used to select factor
